title: Swiftenomics – level 2
paragraphs: Taylor Swift is a very famous singer. Her tours and albums bring money to cities because fans buy tickets, travel, and hotels. Experts call this effect ‘Swiftenomics.’

She can ask for high prices because many people want to see her, but there are few seats. Her success comes from being honest and real. She writes about her life and inspires women. Misty Heggeness says Taylor teaches lessons about leading, creating, and not stopping when things get hard. Taylor changes herself and sells albums in smart ways, like giving many versions to meet high demand.
She also tells stories about women from the past. This helps fans see that women can be strong, smart, and successful in music and life.

words.d: doing well or reaching a goal you want
make someone want to do something
